scope: Current working-tree documentation contracts; all non-archived first-party Cargo manifests plus the exact explicit kernel workspace members. Not execution evidence.

packages.owner: The codec owns byte interpretation only; the kernel profile owns availability and the original Hepta owner owns authority and durable outcomes.
packages.failure_recovery: Reject malformed frames without assigning effect authority; uncertain effects are queried through the real owner rather than replayed by the codec.
packages.current_scope: Bounded no_std wire encoding/decoding and host acceptance; successful parsing does not establish native execution.

packages.owner: ControlCoreWith owns boot-local delivery identity and pins the actual resource allocation; Hepta retains durable logical identity.
packages.failure_recovery: Pending or ambiguous callbacks fence replay and retirement; only the original resource owner can reconcile a possible effect.
packages.current_scope: Host state machine, public lock injection and portable no_std compilation; actual kernel IRQ/preemption/SMP and fsync need independent gates.

packages.owner: A trusted host provides expected Agentd identity and endpoint; this client owns no signer, policy, process launcher or persistent operation state.
packages.failure_recovery: One transport attempt can leave an unknown result; retain the original request and query original history instead of repeating submission.
packages.current_scope: Linux observer plus explicit Objective/history/CPU features; no default device startup and no qualified Windows, Android or Asterinas transport.

packages.owner: Original Root, Fleet, Supervisor, writer and authenticated text session retain authority; the library injects original adapters and the explicit product-root entry composes these same owners.
packages.failure_recovery: PersistenceUnknown fences sends. The explicit entry permits one same-boot clean Current recovery after actual owner and Session retirement and lease expiry; partial or repeated ceremonies refuse without replay.
packages.current_scope: Trusted Linux embedding plus the feature-gated fresh product Root and bounded existing-state recovery; final installed model, input and accessibility acceptance remain separate from source and component checks.

packages.owner: Pure model values describe process, compositor, GPU, Android and permission observations; the trusted platform owners retain real resources.
packages.failure_recovery: Generation changes invalidate modeled surfaces; stale observations stay stale until a fresh owner observation arrives.
packages.current_scope: Pure contract model and packaging support; model success does not prove actual compositor, input method, device reset or permission enforcement.

packages.owner: The model tracks generation and lifecycle states; actual IOMMU, DMA, interrupt and reset ownership remains with future platform adapters.
packages.failure_recovery: Revoke/quiesce/reset ordering is explicit; an unknown or failed device transition cannot be reclassified as successful cleanup.
packages.current_scope: Executable lifecycle model only; no physical DMA pin, IOMMU map, IRQ or device reset implementation.

packages.owner: A downstream fixture implements only the public lock API and borrows synthetic owners; it grants no kernel or Hepta authority.
packages.failure_recovery: Compile-time assertions reject Send guard or public API regressions; failed builds retain their original diagnostic rather than changing backend semantics.
packages.current_scope: Independent bare no_std compilation and public handle checks, without an executable, scheduler, allocator or crash-durability proof.

packages.owner: The driver stages actual production modules and changes only synchronization for modeled fixture threads or the public backend.
packages.failure_recovery: Keep staged sources and failed interleavings; a model counterexample needs an implementation fix rather than a skipped schedule.
packages.current_scope: Bounded host interleaving exploration; real kernel locking, process death and persistent Hepta recovery are independent.

packages.owner: Dependency-free host models own fixture state only; real Session, Notes and original Hepta owners are exercised by separate process tools.
packages.failure_recovery: Assert generation/identity separation, storage refusal and unknown outcomes; preserve raw failures and do not infer owner terminality from a frame marker.
packages.current_scope: Contract models and separately scoped host/window harnesses; physical devices and production effects require their exact execution inputs.

packages.owner: The executable owns a caller-selected scratch socket/files and fixture threads using ordinary process permissions.
packages.failure_recovery: Mismatch or I/O failure exits with error; after a crash retain inputs and select a fresh scratch directory before an explicit cleanup.
packages.current_scope: Small std/Tokio Linux ABI probe; a host run does not qualify the guest binary, complete ABI, Agentd or a desktop session.

packages.owner: Cargo workspace coordinates five Rust host processes/libraries; original Hepta authority and application data remain with their existing owners.
packages.failure_recovery: Build feature/lock/resource combinations together; refuse mismatched resources and reconcile original identities after uncertain dispatch.
packages.current_scope: Linux native egui baseline and explicit original Makepad feature; Asterinas display/input and mobile builds require separate platform gates.

packages.owner: A bounded application worker serializes Notes text, CAS revision, checkpoint and exact app receipts; Hepta owns operation terminality.
packages.failure_recovery: Failed synchronization freezes mutation; normal close waits for the last save ACK, while explicit stop-waiting closes without cancelling, repeating or rolling back an edit. Old incarnation recovery keeps its exclusive store and recovery-only channel.
packages.current_scope: Native Notes, Calculator and restricted Terminal; durable Notes are explicit and ordinary saved-text reopening creates a new target copy.

packages.owner: The broker owns bounded host admission and private target exchange; original authority, identity and durable receipt retirement remain with Hepta.
packages.failure_recovery: Frame/correlation errors poison the effect stream; a separate recovery datagram observes and acknowledges the exact retained receipt.
packages.current_scope: Same-UID host prototype and trusted-owner target seams, without an issuer, kernel CapSpace or replacement effect ledger.

packages.owner: Typed wire/identity models and the application-owned Notes store are shared by consumers; they do not sign or own original Hepta effects.
packages.failure_recovery: Validate bounded checkpoints, custody and exclusive incarnation locks; storage ambiguity remains frozen and stale observations cannot become fresh success.
packages.current_scope: Shared host contracts, private Notes protocol and synchronized app storage; no A05 permission or production authorization mechanism.

packages.owner: Session owns host child process lifecycle, socket generation and bounded workers; original Root/Agentd supplies trusted submission and Notes bootstrap authority.
packages.failure_recovery: Connection I/O has one finite deadline; restart creates a new generation, and lost replies require observation instead of implicit successful cancellation or resend.
packages.current_scope: Linux host process/observer/Objective bridge and explicit private Notes reservation/bootstrap; standalone Session installs no production effect owner.

packages.owner: Shell renders local drafts and original owner projections; optional Makepad borrows the existing ChatWorkspace and authenticated Root text session.
packages.failure_recovery: Restore drafts separately from execution state; recover navigation under the same original request identities and keep unknown cards from minting replacement sends.
packages.current_scope: Rust native host presentation, local draft persistence and opt-in authenticated native text path; actual input/accessibility/platform gates remain separate.

domains.owner: Release tools bind original sources and artifacts; original Root/Agentd retains production authority and deployment inputs.
domains.failure_recovery: Refuse mixed sources, locks or resources; install rollback cannot clear an uncertain operation or issue another grant.
domains.current_scope: Source/package integrity and install/upgrade procedures; combined execution and production authority have separate evidence.

domains.failure_recovery: Retain raw exits, timeouts, full test inventory and ignored cases; filtered or soft-skipped paths cannot be marked complete.
domains.current_scope: Explicit kernel source/build/boot and scoped native runners; platform and whole-product qualification are independent.
